title: Solitaire Drop Huggies
descriptionHtml:
A plain huggie with one stone below it. Each earring is a small polished gold tone huggie with a flat, smooth face, and from a tiny jump ring at its base hangs one round clear cubic zirconia in four fine claws. About 20mm long, the stone sits just below the lobe and moves when you do.

STYLING TIP: Wear them every day on their own, or with a small stud in a second piercing.

Details

  • Length: Approximately 20mm
  • Huggie: Approximately 10.5mm tall, with a 2.5mm wide face
  • Stone: Round clear cubic zirconia, approximately 4mm
  • Setting: Four fine gold claws
  • Closure: Hinged huggie
  • Finish: Polished gold tone

Care

Keep it dry and away from perfume and harsh chemicals. Wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.
